description: Confirm that a company exists, is active and is who it claims to be before onboarding, invoicing or contracting. Searches GLEIF (global, LEI holders only) and Norway's Brønnøysund register by name, LEI or number: legal name, status, number, jurisdiction, address, legal form, incorporation date, parents and (Norway) officers, with source links. UK Companies House is not enabled. Use when you need an official registry record for a counterparty. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, NO, DK, US

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

query.description: Company name, LEI or registry number (auto-detected)

registration_number.description: National registry number (e.g. UK company number, Norwegian org.nr)

name: lookup_company
